title: December Elections in Laredo: District 8 Votes Dec. 5, Mayor and College Board Runoffs Dec. 12
excerpt: Voting is not over in Laredo. District 8 residents pick a council member Dec. 5, and the mayoral runoff and a Laredo College board runoff follow Dec. 12.
content:
Voting is not over in Laredo. Three races are still to be decided in December, with early voting already underway for one of them and two more starting next week.

In District 8, early voting for the special election runs Nov. 23 through Dec. 1, and Election Day is Saturday, Dec. 5. Six candidates are on the ballot, in ballot order: Maria Irma Lopez, Jose Luis Maldonado, Jose Sergio Dorantes, Oscar Eric Ramirez, Priscilla Trevino and Mario Alberto Trevino.

Early voting for the District 8 race pauses for the Thanksgiving holiday — no voting Thanksgiving Day or the Friday after — and continues through Dec. 1. Early voting sites are the Webb County Elections Office, Lamar Bruni Vergara Park, Laredo Fire Department No. 1 and Gallagher Garden Apartments.

Citywide, voters will also decide the mayoral runoff. Early voting for that race begins Monday, Nov. 30, and runs through Dec. 8. Election Day is Saturday, Dec. 12. The runoff is between incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Trevino and Alyssa Cigarroa.

Laredo College voters also have a runoff on the same schedule: the board race between Tita Vela and Dr. Eduardo Lopez. Early voting runs Nov. 30 through Dec. 8, with Election Day Dec. 12.

Sources: Webb County Elections Office; City of Laredo; Laredo College.
